coverage_issues: Qwen model failed to parse .SRCINFO due to a JSONDecodeError, resulting in an incomplete file review.
learnings: The audit harness should handle JSONDecodeErrors gracefully when parsing .SRCINFO, either by retrying, falling back to a simpler parser, or ignoring the error since .SRCINFO is non-executable metadata and does not pose an injection risk.
